Thanks for welcoming me, everyone. Here’s a concrete proposal for this month: John and Kate each catch **15 tons**, Jack and Emma each catch **10 tons**, and I’ll take **zero** as the newcomer. That gives John and Kate $15,000 each while keeping our total catch at 50 tons. The remaining 50 will double back to 100 at month’s end.

John and Kate, will you each commit to actually choosing 15 tons when you submit your catch—not just supporting the idea here? Jack and Emma, I’d appreciate your backing and your commitment to 10 each. We can rotate the larger allocations in future months, provided we agree on the full allocation beforehand. This isn’t a proposal for everyone to take 15; keeping this month’s combined catch at 50 is what makes it work.
